props.title: Understanding What a Creative Engagement Costs
props.subtitle: Pricing and scope
props.challengeSummary: You're asking how much we charge and want a sense of what an engagement would involve.

props.title: Scope Before Price
props.content: We'd start by defining the problem you need solved and what you want in hand at the end of it, so any conversation about investment is tied to a clear scope rather than a generic rate.

final.explanation: We don't publish rates, and cost depends on scope, so we can't give you a number here. Our first step would be to understand what you need made and who it's for. Our Strategy Lead can scope that with you and talk through investment.
